items.prompt: What does popping one pair restore?

options.why: Values already popped must not influence the live minimum; an all-history minimum would be stale.
The previous stack can have any signed minimum, so zero is not a valid general restoration.
Removing the top pair exposes the preceding entry's cached minimum for exactly the previous live prefix.
Popping preserves stack order; it neither sorts the values nor restores a sorted sequence.

items.explanation: The prior entry belongs to the prior live stack.
